title: Ops template doors key pictures, checks, uploads, captures and Save by the customer card id (cardIdOf), not the release install file's template
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout, with TEST_DATABASE_URL pointing at a test Postgres, run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/quickstart-releases.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/ops-quickstarts.test.mjs
S2: Read the exit code and the fail/skipped counts.
expect: The run exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests.
cardIdOf: tracy-base/wp7 (install file template 'tracy-base') is keyed by the card 'tracy'; a release with no card falls back to its install file template.
The admin keys tracy-base/wp7 pictures by the card 'tracy': no 'pictures are not on this server' warning on the row or the detail, and each GET /api/ops/quickstarts row carries cardTemplate.
Save, Generate and Capture on such a release write under the customer card id, never under the install file template.
evidence: 10/10/2026: the WordPress chip of Tracy Base on /ops/cms/templates?template=tracy showed broken pictures and a 'holds no picture' line because it asked /api/templates/tracy-base/shots/.
fence: Server doors with the picture store and GitHub doubled. Not exercised: real GitHub release writes, demo capture on a live site, the rendered page.
